methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified against each vendor's official pricing page (superhuman.com/pricing, shortwave.com/pricing, missiveapp.com/pricing, sparkmailapp.com/pricing, canarymail.io/pricing, spikenow.com/pricing) plus official help/billing docs (help.superhuman.com pricing article, shortwave.com/docs/guides/billing, shortwave.com/docs/guides/security) and compliance pages (missiveapp.com/security, canarymail.io compliance help page, trustlists.org/company/superhuman, trust.superhuman.com, spikenow.com/security). Corrections vs draft: (1) Superhuman email-only Starter tier is discontinued for new subscribers post-Grammarly (email now requires Business) — removed as a sellable priced row; (2) Spark Plus annual discount corrected 18%->13% per vendor's stated 'SAVE 13%'; (3) Spike 'annual only' limit corrected — monthly prices are published. Spark publishes EUR only; USD omitted (monthlyUsd=null). Shortwave Free is a verified free-forever tier (billing docs). accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Superhuman
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified via help.superhuman.com pricing article and agentys.io/en/blog/superhuman-pricing (superhuman.com/pricing is JS-rendered/blocked to scrapers). After the Grammarly acquisition (closed Oct 2025) the standalone email-only Starter tier is no longer offered to NEW subscribers — Superhuman email access now requires the Business plan. A Free tier exists but includes AI chat / Grammarly / Coda and NO Superhuman email. Compliance from trustlists.org and trust.superhuman.com (SafeBase).

plans.name: Free (no email)
plans.notes: Free tier post-Grammarly bundle: AI chat, Grammarly writing assistance, Coda docs. Does NOT include Superhuman email. Listed for completeness; not an email-client tier.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user per month, billed monthly; ~$33/user/mo billed annually (~18% discount). This is now the entry point for Superhuman email access (the old standalone email-only Starter tier at ~$30/mo is no longer sold to new subscribers). Includes Superhuman Mail, keyboard shortcuts, split inbox, instant search, Auto Drafts, Ask AI, Smart Send, Custom Auto Labels, HubSpot/Salesforce/Pipedrive integration, Recent Opens Feed. No free trial for Mail.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Everything in Business plus SAML SSO, BYOK encryption, dedicated support, advanced security and controls.

limits: No free tier for email — the free plan excludes Superhuman email entirely
Superhuman email now requires the Business plan (standalone email-only Starter tier discontinued for new subscribers post-Grammarly)
No BAA — Superhuman does not sign BAAs and advises against sending PHI over email
keyFeatures: AI Auto Drafts and Ask AI
enrichment.provenance: Pricing corroborated via agentys.io deep-dive and Superhuman help center. Compliance: SOC2 Type II + GDPR + CCPA per trustlists.org and trust.superhuman.com; HIPAA false and no BAA per official guidance.

vendors.name: Shortwave
vendors.provenance: Pricing from shortwave.com/pricing; billing/free-tier from shortwave.com/docs/guides/billing (explicitly confirms a permanent free tier, not just a trial); compliance from shortwave.com/docs/guides/security. Gmail/Google Workspace only — no Outlook/IMAP. Paid prices published for annual billing; monthly available but not headlined on the page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Verified free-forever tier for personal Gmail accounts (no Google Workspace). Most productivity features plus Shortwave AI assistant with capped AI usage, basic intelligence, 90-day search history, max 15 threads per AI search, 'Sent with Shortwave' signature. No team collaboration.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $24/seat/month billed annually. Google Workspace support, 5-year AI search history, max 50 threads per AI search, 3 AI-powered filters, AI integrations and web browsing, AI autocomplete and summaries. Monthly billing available but rate not published on pricing page.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: $36/seat/month billed annually. Marked most popular. All Business features plus advanced intelligence, 2x more AI usage, unlimited AI search history, max 100 threads per AI search, 10 AI-powered filters, 2x context tokens.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $100/seat/month billed annually. All Premier features plus expert intelligence, 6x more AI usage, max 150 threads per AI search, 50 AI-powered filters, 3x context tokens.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. For larger organizations with advanced integration, compliance, security, or support requirements. Contact sales.

limits: Gmail and Google Workspace only — no Outlook or IMAP
Free plan: capped AI usage, no Google Workspace, no team features
Annual-only pricing shown publicly; monthly rates not published on the page
keyFeatures: Multi-tiered AI search over full email history
enrichment.provenance: Plan details from official pricing page; free-forever tier confirmed by official billing docs. Compliance page does not publicly assert SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR certification (contact sales), so all set to null.

vendors.name: Missive
vendors.provenance: Pricing from missiveapp.com/pricing (re-verified: $14/$24/$36 monthly, 20% off annual). No free-forever plan — only a 30-day trial. Integrations from missiveapp.com/integrations; compliance from missiveapp.com/security (SOC 2 Type II + GDPR explicit; no HIPAA).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $14/user/month billed monthly; $11.20/user/month billed annually (20% discount). Up to 5 users. Email, SMS, social accounts, team spaces, conversations, tasks. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Productive
plans.notes: $24/user/month billed monthly; $19.20/user/month billed annually (20% discount). Up to 50 users. Adds up to 1,000 rules/automations, external tool integrations, basic analytics, API access.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $36/user/month billed monthly; $28.80/user/month billed annually (20% discount). Unlimited users. Adds SAML SSO, IP restrictions, advanced analytics, personalized team onboarding.

limits: Starter capped at 5 users
Productive capped at 50 users
Rules/automations (up to 1,000) require Productive tier or higher
No free-forever plan — only a 30-day trial
keyFeatures: Shared inbox for teams with collaborative threads
SAML SSO and IP restrictions on Business tier
enrichment.provenance: Plan details from official pricing page (re-verified). Compliance from missiveapp.com/security stating SOC 2 Type II and GDPR; no HIPAA.

vendors.name: Spark Mail
vendors.provenance: Pricing from sparkmailapp.com/pricing — displayed in EUR (no USD published), so monthlyUsd=null for paid plans. Annual discount corrected to the vendor-stated 13% ('SAVE 13%') for both Plus and Pro (draft had 18% on Plus). Compliance from sparkmailapp.com/blog/privacy-explained (GDPR) and HIPAA analysis (not HIPAA-compliant).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Smart Inbox, unlimited email accounts, smart notifications, essential email productivity, calendar. No AI meeting notes or team collaboration.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: EUR10/user/month billed monthly or EUR120/year (EUR8.25/mo equivalent), vendor-stated 'SAVE 13%'. USD not published on official page (monthlyUsd=null). Includes Spark +AI (40 AI meeting notes/month), AI assistant, custom templates, Todoist/Notion/HubSpot integrations, essential team collaboration. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: EUR22/user/month billed monthly or EUR264/year (EUR19.08/mo equivalent), vendor-stated 'SAVE 13%'. USD not published on official page (monthlyUsd=null). Everything in Plus plus unlimited AI meeting notes, read statuses, advanced team collaboration, HubSpot integration, auto-labels/auto-drafts (coming soon), workflows (coming soon), Spark CLI. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contact sales. Everything in Pro plus security and controls, dedicated success manager, 1:1 productivity coaching.

limits: AI meeting notes capped at 40/month on Plus
Paid plan prices shown in EUR only on official page (no USD)
Workflows and auto-labels marked as coming soon on Pro
AI credits quota with notifications at 10% remaining
keyFeatures: Spark +AI meeting notes and AI assistant
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from official page in EUR; annual discount corrected to vendor-stated 13% (was 18% on Plus in draft). GDPR confirmed via Spark privacy blog; not HIPAA-compliant.

vendors.name: Canary Mail
vendors.provenance: Pricing from canarymail.io/pricing ($3/mo Growth, $10/mo Pro+; yearly $36 / $100; lifetime also offered). HIPAA and GDPR explicitly stated on official compliance help page; BAA available on request. SOC2 not stated on any reviewed official page (null).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever, up to 2 devices. Unified inbox, basic read receipts, snooze/pin, email templates, inbox zero tools, basic customization, unlimited mail accounts. 7-day free trial of paid features included (no credit card).

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $3/month or $36/year. Up to 5 devices. Marked most popular. Adds AI copilot, full read receipts, send later, calendar/scheduling, inbox cleaner, app integrations, advanced customization. Lifetime purchase also available.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: $10/month or $100/year (2 months free billed yearly). Up to 5 devices. Marked best value. Adds PGP encryption, SecureSend HIPAA-compliant encrypted email, phishing/ransomware detection, impersonation detection, misdirection prevention, priority support. Lifetime purchase also available.

limits: Free plan limited to 2 devices
Growth and Pro+ plans limited to 5 devices
SOC2 not publicly confirmed
Pro+ required for PGP/SecureSend/HIPAA features
keyFeatures: SecureSend HIPAA-compliant end-to-end encrypted email to anyone
BAA available on request for HIPAA compliance
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from official page. HIPAA + GDPR explicitly stated on official compliance help page; BAA available on request. SOC2 not mentioned (null).

vendors.name: Spike
vendors.provenance: Pricing from spikenow.com/pricing. Two tracks: Teamspace and Email App. CORRECTION vs draft: paid plans are NOT annual-only — monthly prices are published (Team $6/mo, Business $10/mo, Email Pro $8/mo, Email Ultimate $16/mo). monthlyUsd values below are the annual-equivalent monthly rates ($4/$8/$6/$12). Compliance from spikenow.com/security — Bishop Fox/ISE pen test only; no SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR stated.

plans.name: Teamspace Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 3 members. 1 teamspace, @spike.team email address, 60-day search history, 15GB storage, Spike AI, standard support.

plans.name: Teamspace Team
plans.notes: $4/member/month billed annually (or $6/member/month billed monthly, ~33% annual discount). Unlimited members. Unlimited search history, 100GB storage, free custom domain (1 year with annual plan), shared inbox, Spike AI.

plans.name: Teamspace Business
plans.notes: $8/member/month billed annually (or $10/member/month billed monthly, ~20% annual discount). Everything in Team plus 1TB storage, 500MB file uploads, VIP support, video call recording (coming soon), SAML SSO (coming soon).

plans.name: Email App Free
plans.notes: Free forever for individual use. 1 email address, 1:1 video calls, 60-day search history, 1GB storage, 30MB file uploads, Spike AI (10 queries/month).

plans.name: Email App Pro
plans.notes: $6/user/month billed annually (or $8/user/month billed monthly, ~25% annual discount). Up to 3 email addresses, 5-participant video calls, unlimited search history, 5GB storage, 100MB file uploads, unlimited Spike AI, priority support.

plans.name: Email App Ultimate
plans.notes: $12/user/month billed annually (or $16/user/month billed monthly, ~25% annual discount). Unlimited email addresses, 10-participant video calls, unlimited search history, 20GB storage, 1GB file uploads, unlimited Spike AI, VIP support, video recording and SAML SSO (coming soon).

limits: Teamspace Free capped at 3 members
Email App Free limited to 10 AI queries/month and 1 email address
SAML SSO and video recording on roadmap (coming soon)
Monthly and annual billing both offered; headline rates are annual-equivalent monthly
keyFeatures: Built-in video calls and team collaboration
Dual product tracks: Teamspace and individual Email App
WhatsApp shared inbox on team plans
enrichment.provenance: Plan details from official pricing page (monthly + annual both published; 'annual-only' draft claim corrected). Security page confirms Bishop Fox/ISE pen test but no SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR certifications, so all compliance fields null.
